name: Radaris

steps.text: Radaris needs you to finish this one. Go to radaris.com/control-privacy, search for {full_name} and your city, click your own profile, then press the blue "Start Removing" button. Enter {contact_email} as the email address and submit. Radaris emails a link to that address; OpenOptOut clicks it for you.

source: Flow and selectors from Blake104/OptOut (AGPL-3.0), radaris.yml, verified upstream 2026-05-12; process matches BADBOOL's Radaris entry. Email fallback per BADBOOL: customer-service@radaris.com.
notes: Radaris only shows the "Start Removing" button after a person picks their profile from the results, and the page will not let automation click it, so this flow pauses there and becomes a checklist item. The steps after the pause are kept for when the app can hand a live browser to a person and resume. Data commonly reappears within about 60 days; re-run monthly.
